## 사진 1.jpg: /tmp/codex-remote-attachments/01a09519-be6c-7712-8861-8ac5f7609790/90A45C70-1678-4918-B80C-F1A92DBBBEFE/1-사진-1.jpg

## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: User requests independent randomized complex image test concepts, reference-based prompts, generation and literal pixel verification. This arm independently chooses a garment-aware cape lookbook in a coastal ferry terminal; randomized choices are agent-owned.
subject: An adult model in her late twenties with face and long dark wavy hair visually referenced to the attachment
setting: Quiet coastal ferry terminal with sea horizon and chrome folding chair
event: Standing model gently lifts a small section of her cape hem to exhibit drape
visual_priorities: Garment construction and drape stay readable
Reference face and long dark wavy hair remain visually recognizable
Plausible fingers, arm openings, planted boots and cloth contact
baseline_prompt_en: Photograph an adult fashion model in her late twenties, using the supplied portrait as the visual reference for her face and long dark wavy hair. Create a garment-aware fashion lookbook photograph in a quiet coastal ferry terminal. She wears a burgundy wool cape with clearly shaped shoulder seams and a curved lower hem over charcoal tapered trousers and polished black ankle boots. She stands upright with both boot soles planted on the dry concrete floor, feet comfortably apart, and her torso facing the camera. Her right hand emerges through the cape arm opening and gently pinches a small section of the right outer hem between thumb and index finger, holding it a few inches outward; the lifted cloth hangs in a shallow curved fold back toward her right thigh. Her left arm hangs naturally through the left arm opening with the hand visible beside her hip. The cape front, shoulder construction, wool texture, lifted hem edge and complete trouser silhouette remain readable. A single chrome folding chair stands beside her with a clear gap between its frame and her boots. Tall ferry-terminal windows show a subdued sea horizon. Cool skylight defines the burgundy wool, while a small warm side reflection touches one garment edge. Frame her full length with floor beneath both boots, balanced architecture, lifelike skin texture and a calm direct gaze. The photograph presents the actual drape and construction of the garment as its visual center.
